units.source_text: 先是母亲大吃一惊，接着大家异口同声地赞不绝口。

en.t: First Mother was greatly surprised, and then everyone praised me with one voice.

units.source_text: 于是，母亲说：这孩子连假名都没学过，侥幸赢了。

en.t: Then Mother said that this child had not even learned kana and had won by sheer luck.

units.source_text: 大家是到我家里来做客的，不免照顾体面，说上几句好话，对胜负早已置之不顾。

en.t: Since everyone had come to our house as guests, they naturally spared our feelings and said a few kind words, having long since stopped caring about winning or losing.

units.source_text: 连唱牌的人也问道：“姑娘，准备好了吗？”

en.t: Even the person reading the cards asked, Miss, are you ready?

units.source_text: 为了我一人，她们三番五次地慢慢地唱牌。

en.t: For my sake alone, they read the cards slowly again and again.

units.source_text: 后来一连拿了好几张，也全都拿中了。

en.t: After that I picked several more in a row, and every one of them was right.

units.source_text: 可是，即使听了吟诗，它的意思我一点也不明白。

en.t: But even when I heard the poem recited, I did not understand its meaning at all.

units.source_text: 连一首诗我也背不出，一个字也读不下来。

en.t: I could not recite even a single poem, nor could I read a single character aloud.
And yet I had indeed picked the right cards.

units.source_text: 我只是漫不经心地动了动手。

en.t: I had merely moved my hand without thinking.

units.source_text: 从母亲抚摸我脑袋那只手的手心上，我感受到母亲的无限喜悦。

en.t: From the palm of the hand with which Mother was stroking my head, I felt her boundless joy.
